advice: Base: `existing-sme`, SHA-256 `3719c58530161598ab9a537a43be749a5287c8d8dbd35b855e5afea97cd15258`. For n=512 only, pack B inside `gemm` into K-major panels, one 32-column panel per output-column tile, with values laid out so each reduction step loads the panel’s two 16-float halves contiguously. Keep A transpose, four FP32 ZA accumulators, MOPA selectors 0–3, reduction order, stores, and general-size path unchanged. Include allocation and packing in timing. Hypothesis: contiguous panel access may improve B locality enough to offset panel packing; the 64 KiB B panel plus the 64 KiB A tile footprint reaches the reported 128 KiB P-core L1D capacity, so cache pressure may erase any benefit. This is an unverified experiment, not a measured gain.
risks: Panel layout or address calculations could mishandle edges; packing adds allocation and copy cost. Preserve the general GEMM ABI, FP32 values, tolerance 0.002, and all non-512 behavior.
